Managed Antivirus

Antivirus

Protect yourself and your business against known viruses and catch new, hard-to detect malware threats.

Our remotely monitored and managed antivirus helps keep both known and emerging malware off workstations and servers. Managed antivirus keeps current with the latest threats using traditional signature-based protection. It also protects against new viruses using sophisticated heuristic checks and behavioral scanning. With new threats created each day, your business needs to protect itself with proactive measures to ensure the best malware protection.

Key Features

Managed antivirus works constantly with real time monitoring checking against potential threats. It is lightweight, to prevent disruption to you and your staff during working hours Deep scans run at scheduled times to prevent any disruption during working hours.
